name: wordle-lab
description: Playable Wordle with an entropy-based solver that suggests and explains the next guess.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "yarn workspace server start:dev" "yarn workspace web dev"
scripts.build: yarn workspace server build && yarn workspace web build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta --kill-others "node --env-file-if-exists=packages/server/.env packages/server/dist/main.js" "yarn workspace web preview"
scripts.test: yarn workspace server test && yarn workspace web test
